_doc: Staff re-bake (tools/blender/staff.py, docs/BLENDER-PIPELINE.md "staff"). Shared by every Tripo biped hero: positions are metres from the right shoulder in the hero's frame as [forward, right, up], staff directions are [tilt from vertical, azimuth] in degrees (azimuth 0 = leaning forward, 90 = out to the right, 180 = back). Times are 0..1 through the clip. gameLean is DmGearProps.HOLDS.staff today (the grip the original clips are read with); lean is the fist grip the re-baked clips are made for (the game must hold the staff with it when it plays them); wrist is the allowed range of effective lean (ulnar - / radial +) the solver may bend the wrist to.

cast._doc: basic attack (Bone Needle plays cast, trimmed to 1.1 s): cock the head back, point it at the target

flick._doc: bolt: wind back over the shoulder, thrust head-first at release (0.619)

slam._doc: big rite: raise, drive the foot into the floor in front, hold through the crouch, come up with the body. The crouch bottoms out after the release (0.4), so the staff lands at 0.417, 40 ms late.

channel._doc: staff raised in front, head up and leaning at the target

summon._doc: lift the staff to the sky at release (0.5), hold, lower. The hero stands tall through this clip, so a plant would stop ~20 cm short of the floor.
